cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your wedding dress reached our depot this morning. Please sit; I'll look after you.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

mechanism: A presents collection and contact corrections as expert care, reducing a stranded customer's access to information with each question.
confusable: A helpful expert would supply a route to the dress; D141 makes each kindly correction less informative.
comparison: Commercial dependence and an urgent garment differ from family emotional protection.
seedUse: Use depot arrival and denied direct contact, replacing the generic standard with corrections of B's proposed next steps.
